spans.text: Bremen, Germany.
City Hall.
Knock knock.
Come in.
Welcome... Do I still need to call you K?
Or should it be Herr Schwaben?
Call me whatever you want.
Why have you sent for me?
Asking questions like that only serves to lower my opinion of you, Kain.
Of course, if you truly do not know, then please close the door.
You're as sharp as ever, even though I've only just returned.
I'm very glad to see that you've made it back alive.
However, the wheels keep turning, and there's no time for us to catch our breath.
I've wasted enough time on mere pleasantries.
Your job is to be the kindly face.
But was everything you told Ange also mere pleasantries?
...Not all of it.
Those Soviets saved my life, and my gratitude to her and her friends is sincere. I also believe that we wish for the same thing.
However, the fact that we're on different sides means that on the surface, at least, we cannot be truly frank and earnest with each other.
I'm sure she feels the same way.
However, there's a reason the Prometheans sent her over.
There'll definitely be a chance for us to work with Ange.
We've all seen her abilities, and she wants to solve the same problems that we do.
Also, she brought those two very useful Dolls with her.
Perhaps I'll be able to collect more data on them. After all, that fox was clearly hiding things from us last time.
But considering the problems she's facing, even the protection of the Wolf Pack is only delaying the inevitable.
The information Angelia possesses is enough to draw the world's attention.
It's not only us. "They" are also watching, ready to strike.
So the centipede keeps writhing, even when it's dead...
I guess this is their last stand.
Pathetic wretches.
They actually believe that they can use "Relics" to turn the tide.
Are the examples set by those politicians being arrested in Moscow not able to sway those numbskulls?
Idiots are often overly confident in themselves.
I will not let them touch Ange.
Very good. That is also your responsibility.
But don't underestimate the opposition. They still have enough backing to put up a fight right now.
You can glimpse their hand at work in the refugee situation.
...What foolish chauvinists.
My people have been following the matter for a long time.
We'll get to the bottom of this.
It's not enough to get to the bottom of it, K.
We need to rip them up by the roots... But that is another matter.
I asked for you today because of...
The information Ange possesses?
Nobody knows what she found in William's lab besides her.
Not even you—who was present at the time—had the chance to come into contact with it.
The Prometheans aren't going to just hand over something that important.
Also, it's more reassuring to have certain things in your own hands.
I understand... Though there's one thing that intrigues me.
Ange and that Griffin Commander are on the same side. A civilian company is easier to handle than the Prometheans.
Have you considered taking advantage of that?
I can't, Kain.
That much is obvious.
I'm not an ungrateful person.
If I used Griffin as a bargaining chip, then I would definitely lose Ange's trust.
Personally, I quite like Angelia. Both she and the Commander are brave and upright people, and I am glad to call them my friends.
However, we can't always be on the same side due to national interests.
Right now, her trump card is that information from William's lab, which she won't divulge so easily for obvious reasons.
Fortunately, we've booked ourselves the best seats in the house.
Protect her, gain her trust, and the rest will surely follow.
Of course, I understand. However...
I believe that's not all you want to say?
If that was it, there'd be no need for you to summon me here.
...Yes. Frankly speaking, you are one of the few people in Bremen I can trust.
There are some personal things which I can only share with you.
To be honest, having that much trust placed in me is a little unsettling.
As the "Chairwoman", every word I just said was sincere.
We need Relic technology. Even if we don't use it ourselves, we need to have it in our hands for the sake of the Volk.
But as "Ulrich"...
Even if Angelia makes up her mind and refuses to leak any information...
I still do not want to see her harmed or threatened.
There are some matters over which I do not have full control.
There is still a lot of noise within the government, and it will take time for Rossartrism to be accepted.
Do you understand what I'm getting at, K?
So there are still many ruthless people out there...
And some of them are my superiors.
Well, this is quite the personal request. Still, you could have made it part of official business.
Regardless, I know how to proceed with the mission.
It's just...
Yes...?
It's just a bit surprising that you're being so honest, given that you're a politician.
Leaving me aside, if you told anyone else about this and they had it on tape...
Well, I imagine that would be the end of your career.
I know the risks I'm taking.
But I feel that I need to tell you what I really think.
Why is that? Why do you care so much about her?
Our ultimate goal is to become the shining beacon in a brave new world, K.
I often think back to those days in Belgrade.
This world needs people like Angelia. She doesn't just represent herself, but those who are like her as well.
She might be a Soviet, but the world has the impetus to forge ahead because of people like her as well as the Commander who saved me.
Only humans can improve humanity.
If you ask me, that spirit is far more valuable than Relic Technology.
I understand.
Thank you.
You're welcome. Frankly speaking, that is my intention as well.
But there's one more thing I'd like to ask you about.
"Paradeus"?
Yes... In other words, the reason why Ange has paid us this visit.
We know very little about them.
And I can't spare the manpower to dig into it. All we can do is take the minimum necessary measures to protect ourselves against them.
Our agency believes they have already infiltrated our government.
If that's true, it would explain the foolish actions taken by "them".
After all, it would be very hard for someone who was not a spy to do such things.
Ange will take care of them for us. All you need to do is work with her.
Very well. I'll take care of it.
Who's in charge of the operation?
It's "J".
...Don't look at me like that.
He's the best man for the job.
...Let's leave that aside for now.
You may go.
Remember, don't give your trust easily.
Even the people close to you might be spies for "them".
And what about the people you assigned to Ange?
They...
Click—
Ah... Sorry.
It's alright, go ahead and take it.
Of course.
...What?
Wait a minute, don't hang up, explain—!
Click.
Was it J?
...Excuse me, ma'am. I have to leave now.
Angelia's been attacked.
Go.
And make sure she's safe!
Understood!
